card.fact_statement: Ahmed Mohamed Odowaa was slated for deportation to Italy on 5 April 2025.
card.source_span: On 5 April 2025, 30-year-old Somali national Ahmed Mohamed Odowaa, who had intervened when the two passersby were attacked and was one of three men who had chased down the perpetrator, was slated for deportation to Italy per the Dublin Regulation.

target_qa_variants.question: อาเหม็ด โมฮาเหม็ด โอโดวา มีกำหนดถูกเนรเทศไปยังอิตาลีในวันที่เท่าใด จากความเกี่ยวข้องกับเหตุการณ์ไล่แทงที่อชัฟเฟินบวร์คในปี 2025
answer_aliases: วันที่ 5 เมษายน 2025
target_qa_variants.source_span: On 5 April 2025, 30-year-old Somali national Ahmed Mohamed Odowaa, who had intervened when the two passersby were attacked and was one of three men who had chased down the perpetrator, was slated for deportation to Italy per the Dublin Regulation.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'Aschaffenburg' to 'อชัฟเฟินบวร์ค' and kept the year 2025 in Gregorian calendar format as is standard for international news in Thai.

backtranslation_en.question: On what date was Ahmed Mohamed Odowa scheduled to be deported to Italy due to his involvement in the 2025 Aschaffenburg stabbing incident?
